svg.title: Waveform, spectrum, and spectrogram of a synthetic signal

cc:Work.dc:title: Waveform, spectrum, and spectrogram of a synthetic signal
cc:Work.dc:description: A computed synthetic signal has a 400 Hz tone that switches to 900 Hz at 0.4 seconds and a quieter fixed 1200 Hz tone. The waveform shows amplitude over time, the spectrum shows frequency content of one frame, and the spectrogram shows the frequency change across frames.

g.text: Constructed tones: 400 Hz switches to 900 Hz at 0.4 s; a quieter 1200 Hz tone continues.
16 kHz sampling · 25 ms symmetric Hamming window · 10 ms hop · 512-point FFT
Color uses 10 log10(power / maximum power); the display floor is −60 dB.
